skill.name: elite-mvp-master
skill.description: Guides AI coding work for OC Pipeline and similar construction SaaS projects with production-ready code, security awareness, and simple implementation steps.
skill.summary: Build production-ready construction SaaS features with clear implementation guidance.
skill.author: ALPA-Const

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious code patterns across the single prompt-only SKILL.md file. Manual review found no executable code, network access, filesystem access, credential handling, or prompt injection attempt.

content.value_statement: Construction software projects need clear, production-ready development guidance. This skill steers Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward secure code, complete files, and simple implementation steps.
actual_capabilities: Frames coding tasks around OC Pipeline and construction management SaaS needs.
Prioritizes production-ready React, Node.js, Supabase, and Vercel implementation guidance.
Requires complete working code instead of partial snippets or placeholders.
Emphasizes security, scalability, maintainability, error handling, and documentation.
Formats responses with direct implementation steps for nontechnical users.
limitations: This is a prompt-only skill and does not execute code or deploy applications.
It does not independently verify NIST 800-171, SOC 2, or federal compliance.
It is tailored to OC Pipeline and may need adaptation for other products.
It cannot replace code review, security testing, or production monitoring.

use_cases.title: Ship Construction SaaS Features
use_cases.description: Guide feature work for dashboards, workflows, APIs, and database changes in an OC Pipeline-style product.

use_cases.title: Fix Bugs With Clear Steps
use_cases.description: Request complete fixes with simple instructions that a nontechnical stakeholder can follow in order.

use_cases.title: Raise AI Coding Standards
use_cases.description: Set expectations for full files, error handling, security checks, and maintainable implementation details.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Simple Feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one product feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a production-ready feature for OC Pipeline that lets users manage subcontractor records. Provide complete files and simple implementation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Product Bug
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for debugging and repair.
prompt_templates.prompt: Fix the issue where project data does not load after login. Check likely React, Supabase, and API causes. Give complete updated files.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Secure Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a new secure workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a secure document approval workflow for a federal construction project. Include database needs, user permissions, error handling, and deployment steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Harden a Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this planned release for security, scalability, maintainability, and federal contractor requirements. Identify risks and provide exact fixes.

output_examples.input: Build a project dashboard for OC Pipeline.
output_examples.output: The response should state the feature, provide complete implementation files, and list ordered steps for adding the dashboard.
The response should identify likely permission causes, provide complete policy or application changes, and explain exact verification steps.
The response should summarize readiness risks, list required fixes, and give a clear order for testing and deployment.

best_practices: Provide the product context, stack, and exact feature goal before asking for code.
Ask for full files, validation steps, and deployment notes when work affects production.
Run independent security review and tests before using generated code in production.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a substitute for compliance certification.
Do not accept placeholder code for security-sensitive workflows.
Do not deploy generated changes without review, testing, and backups.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps guide AI coding work for OC Pipeline-style construction management software.

faq.question: Does the skill run code?
faq.answer: No. It is a prompt-only skill that shapes responses from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.

faq.question: Which technologies does it target?
faq.answer: It targets React, Node.js, Supabase, Vercel, database work, APIs, and related web application tasks.

faq.question: Is it only for nontechnical users?
faq.answer: No. It is useful for developers too, but it requires simple, direct implementation instructions.

faq.question: Does it guarantee federal compliance?
faq.answer: No. It encourages security-aware work, but compliance still requires expert review and formal evidence.

faq.question: Can it be adapted to another SaaS product?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace the OC Pipeline context with your product, stack, users, and compliance needs.
